controls.control: Require strong authentication for privileged administrative access
Use role-based least privilege and separate privileged roles from standard user access
controls.evidence: role definitions, assignments and access reviews

controls.control: Apply deny-by-default segmentation between unrelated production trust zones
Prefer short-lived workload identity over embedded static credentials
Encrypt sensitive data in transit and at rest according to data classification
Centralize identity, network and workload security telemetry
controls.evidence: central log ingestion and correlation queries

controls.control: Maintain and test emergency access for identity or policy-control-plane failure
controls.evidence: break-glass test record and access audit
